# `st_asbinary`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
st_asbinary(geo[, endianness])
```

Returns the geospatial value (value of type GEOGRAPHY or GEOMETRY) in WKB format using the specified endianness ('NDR' for little-endian, 'XDR' for big-endian), if provided. Defaults to little-endian encoding.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `st_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- st_asbinary, example 1
> SELECT hex(st_asbinary(st_geogfromwkb(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040')));
0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040
```

```sql
-- st_asbinary, example 2
> SELECT hex(st_asbinary(st_geomfromwkb(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040'), 'XDR'));
00000000013FF00000000000004000000000000000
```
